source_title: CleanFrame for Android TV & Google TV — A quiet, distraction-free home launcher inspired by Samsung The Frame with Art Mode screensaver - GitHub
source_excerpt:
A quiet, distraction-free home launcher inspired by Samsung The Frame — with Art Mode screensaver, remote D-Pad navigation, and DPR auto-scaling for Android TV.
CleanFrame Android TV is an open-source, ultra-minimalist home launcher designed specifically for Android TV and Google TV devices (such as Xiaomi Mi TV, Chromecast with Google TV, Sony Bravia, Nvidia Shield, and TCL TVs).
Ported from Nathan Clark's CleanFrame (originally built for Samsung The Frame on Tizen), this project brings the same serene aesthetic, high-res photographic art gallery, and zero-distraction interface to the Android TV ecosystem.
Quick Wi-Fi & Ethernet Network Settings : Dedicated status icon situated directly to the left of Art Mode. Clicking it immediately launches the native Android TV Network & Internet list for fast Wi-Fi connection switching and configuration. Automatically detects active network type (Wi-Fi vs Ethernet).
Quick Wi-Fi & Ethernet Network Settings :
Dedicated status icon situated directly to the left of Art Mode.
Clicking it immediately launches the native Android TV Network & Internet list for fast Wi-Fi connection switching and configuration.
Automatically detects active network type (Wi-Fi vs Ethernet).
Full-Screen Art Mode Screensaver : Turns your TV into an authentic museum art piece on the wall. Zero UI : All docks, status text, clocks, and overlays vanish into 100% pure art canvas. Interactive Remote Controls : Press Left or Right on the TV remote to browse artworks; press any key to wake back up to the Home screen. Auto-Slideshow : Seamlessly cycles through high-resolution curated gallery photos every 45 seconds. Auto-Idle Timer : Automatically launches Art Mode screensaver after 3 minutes of inactivity on the Home screen.

Universal Display Scaling (720p / 1080p / 4K) : Engineered with real physical display geometry and devicePixelRatio compensation. Fits 720p TVs (such as Xiaomi Mi TV 32" tvdpi ), 1080p, and 4K UHD displays to the exact millimeter with zero cropping.

Live TV & HDMI 1 Switching (PlayStation 5) : Integrates with Android's TvInputManager ( com.droidlogic.tvinput / passthrough service) for one-click switching to your console or cable box.

Smart Google Play Store Redirection : If a highlighted streaming app (Disney+, Prime Video, Stremio, Netflix, Spotify) is not yet installed, clicking its card directs straight to the official Google Play Store ( com.android.vending ) install page instead of showing an error. Fixes regional package discrepancies (e.g., official global com.disney.disneyplus ).

launch(packageName) : Resolves package and launches Leanback / standard intent, or redirects to Play Store.
openHdmi(port) : Switches TV input to HDMI 1 via Android TV Input Framework.
openSettings() : Opens native Android TV system settings.
openNetworkSettings() : Opens native Android TV Network & Internet settings.
enterArtMode() : Triggers full-screen art screensaver.
getInstalledAppsJson() : Queries installed TV apps dynamically.
Android Studio Ladybug / Meerkat or Android SDK command-line tools.
A TV running Android 9.0 (Pie) or newer with ADB debugging enabled.
The compiled APK will be generated at: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
Connect to your TV over Wi-Fi or USB:
Press the Home button on your TV remote.
Android TV will prompt you to select the default launcher.
Choose CleanFrame and select Always .
(To revert at any time, go to TV Settings → Apps → Special app access → Default home app, or uninstall the APK via adb uninstall com.example.tv ) .
